key.name: mode
key.description: desktop = work display on and TV off, tv = TV on and work display off, custom = a layout the user arranged themselves, which is never enforced.

key.name: enforce
key.summary: Re-assert the chosen mode when a display is plugged in or powered on

key.name: enforce-on-startup
key.summary: Also re-assert the chosen mode when the extension starts
key.description: Corrects a session that already logged in on the wrong screen.

key.name: work-connector
key.summary: Connector of the work display, empty for automatic
key.description: Automatic picks the first DisplayPort/embedded panel that is not the TV.

key.name: tv-connector
key.summary: Connector of the TV, empty for automatic
key.description: Automatic picks the first HDMI connector.

key.name: tv-only-by-toggle
key.summary: Only switch to the TV through Display Anchor
key.description: A layout change that leaves only the TV on, but did not come from the TV Mode toggle or its shortcut, is put back to the work display instead of being adopted. An HDMI TV in standby still counts as connected, so such a change would otherwise leave a black screen until TV mode was switched off again. The cost is that choosing "TV only" in Settings is undone too; other layouts, such as an extended desktop, are still adopted. Needs enforce.

key.name: revert-on-tv-gone
key.summary: Return to the work display when the TV disconnects
key.description: Guarantees that powering the TV on later does nothing until TV mode is chosen again.

key.name: tv-grace-seconds
key.summary: How long the TV may vanish before TV mode is dropped
key.description: Receivers and HDR mode changes drop the HDMI link for a few seconds mid-game; this stops that from ending TV mode.

key.name: notify
key.summary: Show a notification when the layout is corrected

key.name: last-work-mode
key.summary: The mode the work display was last seen running on its own
key.description: Written automatically, not a preference. Mutter stores a display mode alongside each layout, so the configuration it loads when the TV appears or disappears can bring the work display back at a fixed refresh rate even though it leaves the desktop on the right screen; restoring this mode is what keeps variable refresh rate from being lost that way. It is only recorded from a layout somebody chose deliberately, so switching variable refresh off in Settings is remembered rather than fought.

key.name: last-work-color-mode
key.summary: The colour mode the work display was last seen using on its own
key.description: Written automatically, not a preference; -1 means nothing is remembered yet. The companion of last-work-mode, for the same reason. A display configuration is a complete description of the monitor, so one that does not name a colour mode puts it back to plain SDR -- which is how HDR was being switched off every time the desktop came back from the TV. Restoring this puts it back. Like last-work-mode it is only recorded from a layout somebody chose deliberately, so switching HDR off in Settings is remembered rather than fought.

key.name: persist-changes
key.summary: Write corrections to the system display configuration
key.description: Off, corrections are applied silently. On, they are also written to Mutter's stored configuration, which cures the jump at its root so the TV powering on causes no switch at all -- but GNOME then asks "Keep these display settings?" each time, and reverts if you do not answer. Worth turning on once to heal a bad stored configuration, then off again.

key.name: switch-audio
key.summary: Also move the sound output when the display mode changes
key.description: Off by default: this takes over the default audio output, which is a bigger thing to do behind the user's back than moving a display.

key.name: work-audio-sink
key.summary: Sound output for the work display, empty for automatic
key.description: An output id, sink|port, or a bare sink name for a portless network sink. Automatic uses the output in use at the time, then the one used before the sound moved to the TV, then local hardware that is not an HDMI or DisplayPort output.

key.name: tv-audio-sink
key.summary: Sound output for the TV, empty for automatic
key.description: An output id, sink|port. Automatic picks the first HDMI or DisplayPort output.

key.name: last-work-output
key.summary: The output in use just before the sound moved to the TV
key.description: Written automatically, not a preference. Switching back to the work display restores this rather than guessing, so a deliberate choice is not quietly replaced by the most likely-looking device. Only consulted when the work output is set to automatic.

key.name: audio-settle-seconds
key.summary: How long to keep re-asserting the sound output after a change
key.description: HDMI audio appears a moment after the display does, and the desktop may grab it on its own, so the choice is re-asserted for a short window rather than once.

key.name: debug
key.summary: Log every decision to the journal
key.description: Writes each hotplug, adopted layout, plan and apply to the gnome-shell journal, prefixed with [display-anchor]. Off by default because it logs on every display change.

key.name: toggle-tv-mode
key.summary: Shortcut that switches between the work display and the TV
